submitted.rationale: EQE is very low near MgSb2O6 stoichiometry (idx22: 0.003%) and Mg-rich (idx12: 0.0002%), and rises in the Sb-rich region beyond the trirutile phase. Among the measured candidates, idx25 (Sb 0.74) had the highest EQE at 0.0318%, above idx28 (0.0271%) and idx27 (0.0245%). That suggests a local maximum near Sb about 0.74.
